question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

One of the most common causes of anosmia and hyposmia is a virus that producing upper respiratory infections.

options.text: anosmia and hyposmia is a virus
One of the most common causes of

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "producing".
 
• The correct form should be "produces" to agree with the subject "a virus".
 
• The correct phrase should be "a virus that produces upper respiratory infections," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"One of the most common causes of anosmia and hyposmia is a virus that **produces** upper respiratory infections."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "anosmia and hyposmia is a virus,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "One of the most common causes of,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 4.
